summary: PO 2025 (26 June 2025) section 8: 36 ECTS basic areas (Mathematics 6, Sustainability 6, Mobility 6, lecture series and practical project 18), 0 to 30 ECTS bridging modules (Angleichmodule) depending on admission, at most 12 ECTS cross-specialization (Angleichmodule Schwerpunktübergreifend) and at most 18 ECTS in Angleichmodule Schwerpunkt, 24 ECTS in one specialization and 0 to 30 ECTS electives, 90 ECTS in total plus the 30-ECTS thesis. The lecture series and practical project is three compulsory 6-ECTS parts, so it is not a choice slot. No cross-specialization bridging module is offered this semester. The Mobility basic area has no modules in this semester's data. Smart Vehicular Information Technologies offers only one 6-ECTS module this semester, so its 24 ECTS cannot be completed from this list.

categories.name: Specialization bridging modules
categories.note: 0-18 ECTS only if admission imposes bridging (section 6 (3) and section 8 (3)), inside the 0-30 Angleich total and not compulsory for every student. Section 8 (3) is one shared area, so modules may come from any specialization bridging list up to 18 ECTS. These credits reduce how many electives are needed to reach 90 ECTS.

categories.name: Electives
categories.note: 0-30 ECTS (section 8 (5)). With bridging modules this fills the gap from 36 ECTS basic areas plus 24 ECTS specialization up to 90 ECTS (section 8 (7)); a full 30-ECTS bridging load leaves no electives. The legal catalog is wider than this area: unused Mathematics, Sustainability or Mobility basic modules, specialization modules not counted in the chosen specialization, and modules the examination board approves also count, and a module must not be counted twice.
